title: Sleep Needs Backup Tonight
caption: Pain sensitivity may need a wider buffer today. Take it easy and shift plans if you need—try a few minutes of slow breathing and a short walk or gentle stretches between tasks.
snapshot: Unsettled bands and an elevated solar wind mood. Recent CME activity has left a livelier background hum. The field tilt leans southward, which can add to the edgy feel. Expect a stormy, flickering-streetlight kind of day.
affects: Wired/tired: You may feel alert in bursts and drained after. Head pressure: Some people report mild head tightness. Mood: Small frustrations might feel louder than usual.
playbook:
- Do 3–5 minutes of slow breathing to reset
- Try easy movement: a short walk or gentle stretches
- Space heavy tasks with short rests
- Stay hydrated and keep caffeine gentle

fb.caption: Can’t sleep even when your body feels tired? Today has a stormy backdrop with recent bursts of solar activity and a livelier-than-usual Schumann tone, which for some folks means the quiet parts of the night don’t land as easily. If you’re noticing wakeful zoomies, try a shorter evening routine and softer screens an hour before bed instead of powering through late tasks. Keep the pressure off yourself: small steps like gentle stretching and slow breathing can help the night feel less bouncy. Notice what shifts and make the rest you can — Gaia Eyes
